events.description: Multiple individuals, including players in red and orange jerseys and others in street clothes, are engaged in mutual physical combat on the basketball court. The altercation escalates across frames with pushing, grabbing, and shoving; at least one person is seen falling to the floor (e.g., frame f7), and multiple people are actively involved in scuffling.

A large group of people—including players, coaches, officials, and possibly spectators—converges into a chaotic, violent cluster on the court, with multiple simultaneous physical confrontations and loss of order. This exceeds a simple two-person fight and constitutes collective violent unrest.

A large-scale physical altercation involving multiple individuals, including players in red jerseys and others in civilian clothing (e.g., white shirts, blue suits), on a basketball court. Participants are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other; the crowd is densely packed and actively engaged in the scuffle throughout the sequence.

A man in a light suit (likely a coach or official) is seen repeatedly striking or grabbing the face/neck area of a tall player in a white and blue uniform (Ezra Williams), who is largely passive and does not retaliate. The interaction escalates from close confrontation to physical contact involving multiple individuals attempting to separate them.

The initial altercation triggers a broader scuffle involving multiple players, officials, and possibly security personnel; the scene becomes chaotic with many people converging and pushing in a confined area near the sideline, indicating collective violent unrest beyond a one-on-one fight.

A multi-person physical altercation involving players, officials, and spectators on the basketball court sideline; individuals are seen grappling, pushing, and restraining each other in a chaotic cluster.

A large-scale physical altercation involving multiple individuals, including players and spectators, on the basketball court. People are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other in a chaotic cluster near the sideline.

Collective violent unrest: a dense crowd of players, officials, security (in white caps), and spectators is engaged in sustained chaotic physical conflict across the court, with no clear separation between groups and widespread aggressive behavior.

A multi-person physical altercation erupts on the basketball court involving players in red/orange and white uniforms, with referees and other personnel attempting to separate them. The fight escalates from initial shoving (f0–f1) to a large scrum with multiple participants grappling (f2–f10), and gradually de-escalates as officials intervene (f11–f15).
